changeRecord.title: section swapped for a heavier one
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A heavier section looks safe, but stiffness attracts force: in an indeterminate structure the stiffer member takes a larger share of the moment, so the demands on the joints and on the neighbouring members change, and the member's own ratios drop -- a model that reports a comfortable ratio for a section that is not the one built.
changeRecord.precondition: a member for which a heavier section of the same kind exists (in the model or in the generic catalogue of the generators)

reference.note: the reference solution is the analysis (and design) of the perturbed model, once verified

verification.route: benchfea verify: every applicable tier; tier C (two independent solvers) is expected to be able to follow the perturbed model

verification.meaning: 'verified' means only: the reference solution passed every tier listed as applicable in this record, at the tolerances stated in it. It does not mean reviewed, approved or certified by anyone.

A.summary: not a model the ODE oracle can represent: the members are not collinear with identical local axes

C.summary: 2 combination(s) cross-checked by OpenSeesPy and PyNite
